name: Multi-Controller Tester
author: Drewworks
description_short: Test multiple GameCube controller inputs at the same time.
description_long: Multi-Controller Tester is a GameCube utility for checking multiple controller inputs at the same time on real hardware. Emulator support is not tested or supported upstream.
